chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The Imams are from Quraysh."
ai.seo_question: Who are the Imams according to the Prophet's declaration in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, underscores the specific tribal criterion of Quraysh for the Imamate, a key point of distinction in Shia jurisprudence regarding the qualifications of the Twelve Imams. It reinforces the concept of *Nass* (divine designation) by linking the spiritual authority of the Imams to their noble lineage from the Prophet's tribe, thereby validating their leadership within the broader context of Islamic history.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-273 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
the Prophet (S) said, “The Imams (a.s.) are all going to be from the Quraysh (tribe).”
